name: emoji-maker/telegram-premium-emoji-maker
description: Telegram premium animated custom emoji maker (WEBM / TGS / PNG) with bot, job queue and admin panel - pure PHP core.

suggest.ext-zip: Required to deliver outputs as ZIP archives
suggest.ext-sodium: Encrypts secrets stored in the database (falls back to OpenSSL)
suggest.ext-fileinfo: Stronger MIME detection for uploaded images
suggest.ext-posix: Better process control for the CLI worker
suggest.ext-pcntl: Graceful shutdown of the daemon worker on SIGTERM
